# Theianex

> Theianex is an Australian paraplanning company built around technology. Our paraplanners use ParaIQ, our in-house AI assistant, to prepare advice documents such as Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs), prepare client files and review documents for Australian financial advisers and advice firms. AI assists with drafting and checking, a paraplanner reviews every document, and the adviser remains responsible for the advice and for signing off. Theianex does not provide personal advice to clients. Legal entity: Theianex Pty Ltd, ACN 703 036 355, ABN 77 703 036 355.
